hero.title: Verify coherence between your goal and financial instrument
hero.description: A neutral verification tool that analyzes compatibility between your investment objectives and available financial instruments characteristics.

context.title: Comparison portals are often remunerated through affiliations
context.description1: Most financial comparison services receive commissions from product providers. This can influence which instruments are promoted or how they are presented.
context.description2: Tradelia provides coherence checks based on objective criteria, without commercial affiliations with financial product providers.

step1.title: 1. Goal definition
step1.description: You specify your investment objective: time horizon, risk tolerance, available amount and investment purpose.

step2.title: 2. Instrument analysis
step2.description: Enter the characteristics of the financial instrument you are considering: costs, liquidity, risk, minimum duration.

step3.title: 3. Coherence verification
step3.description: The system compares objective and instrument, highlighting any incompatibilities according to predefined coherence criteria.

examples.title: Common incompatibilities between objectives and instruments
examples.example1: Short-term objective (6 months) with instrument locked for 2 years
examples.example2: Low risk tolerance with single stock investment
examples.example3: Annual costs above 2% for long-term investments

methodology.title: Verification criteria based on academic standards
methodology.description1: The coherence criteria used are derived from established principles of portfolio theory and guidelines from European supervisory bodies (ESMA, Consob).
methodology.description2: Each verification is traceable and based on objective parameters: no subjective evaluations or market forecasts are used.

limits.title: What we don't do
limits.limit1: We do not provide personalized investment advice
limits.limit2: We do not predict future performance of instruments
limits.limit3: We do not consider individual tax situation
limits.limit4: We do not replace advice from a qualified advisor

cta.title: Verify your instrument's coherence
cta.description: Start the coherence verification between your objectives and the financial instrument you are considering.
